48.original: Good news, adventurer! While you were away, Mistress Krile completed her work on the Aethernet relay, allowing us to access another region of the island!

49.original: I'm told it's quite different from Anemos─far, far colder, on account of a preponderance of ice-aspected aether. Accordingly, the team dubbed it “Pagos.”

50.original: They've already established a new base camp, and if you'd like to lend a hand with the expedition, you'd be more than welcome.

51.original: Just say the word and I'll see to the arrangements. I'm sure Mistress Krile will be overjoyed to see you again!

52.original: You now have access to the Forbidden Land, Eureka Pagos. Like Anemos, Pagos can be explored in parties of up to eight players, or solo.

53.original: To embark on your journey to Pagos, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane.

54.original: Please be advised that all excursions into the Forbidden Land, Eureka Pagos, are item level synced. Gear exceeding an item level of <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8021503> will be adjusted.
